summary: RAG adapt: rewrite nearest exemplar's 7 gold Qs one-to-one
hypothesis: Forcing the model to adapt each of the nearest exemplar's 7 concrete gold questions one-to-one to the new task should transfer the exemplar's full dimension span, because the hard constraints remove the model's freedom to drop important unknowns.
technique: A RAG pipeline retrieves the single nearest gold exemplar, then a single on-device FM call is prompted with those 7 concrete questions as hard one-to-one rewrite constraints — the model must surface-adapt each question to the new task while preserving its underlying unknown.

stages.text: Rewrite each gold Q one-to-one for task
